P2.title: Non-atomic read-modify-write in reserveCalendarSlot under distributed edge storage
P2.detail: reserveCalendarSlot reads the persisted calendar JSON blob, checks window availability, and writes back without an atomic CAS/Lua lock. Under simultaneous concurrent requests targeting the exact same slot on Upstash/Blob/KV, a narrow TOCTOU race could overwrite a concurrent pending hold.
P2.recommendation: For high-concurrency scale, enforce per-slot atomic locks (e.g., Upstash Redis SET key leadId NX EX or Lua script) before persisting the schedule state.

P2.title: Google Sheets appendRow does not neutralize leading formula characters
P2.detail: User-supplied text fields (name, email, notes) are appended directly into Google Sheets cells. Values starting with '=', '+', '-', or '@' could be interpreted as spreadsheet formulas when viewed in Google Sheets.
P2.recommendation: Prefix any string cell value matching /^[=+\-@]/ with a single apostrophe (') prior to calling sheet.appendRow().

P2.title: Minor secret fallback asymmetry and env var name in admin auth error copy
P2.detail: lead-pipeline.ts resolves signingSecret from TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET || ADMIN_ACTION_SECRET, whereas functions/api/admin-action.ts GET also falls back to ADMIN_DASHBOARD_SECRET. Additionally, admin/calendar.astro line 318 names ADMIN_DASHBOARD_SECRET in its client-side invalid-key message (no secret value is leaked).
P2.recommendation: Align fallback precedence across lead-pipeline.ts and admin-action.ts, and use a generic 'Invalid admin key' message in the client bundle.

P2.title: Trailing colon visible in mobile seasonal strip heading
P2.detail: On 390px mobile viewport (mobile-home-v2.png), hiding the secondary offer sentence leaves 'Move-Out Inspection Rush:' with a trailing colon above the CTA buttons.
P2.recommendation: Hide the trailing colon alongside the secondary span on <sm viewports.
